In detail

Cambridgeshire Constabulary recorded 443 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — 13.7 per 1,000 residents, the 3rd highest rate of Cambridge's 14 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (28), vehicle crime (8), burglary (7); the evening/night score by violent crime (41), anti social behaviour (20), public order (9). Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Abbey safe?

Wandroz currently rates Abbey in Cambridge as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Cambridge during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Cambridge at night. This rating is derived from Cambridgeshire Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Abbey safe at night?

At night, Abbey is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Cambridge. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Abbey a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Abbey's day rating (an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Cambridge) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. You can search accommodation already filtered to this specific area using the Booking.com link on this page.
